miente: miente — mind (fem. noun, Latin mentem; venir en miente 'to come to mind': ¿non te viene en miente…? 'does it not come to your mind…?'; = mente)
desató: desatar — he/it untied, set free (preterite 3rd sg.; with reflexive se, el león se desató 'the lion broke loose'; = desató, se desató)
fizist: fazer — you did (preterite 2nd sg., shortened -ist for -iste; ¿qué fizist? 'what did you do?'; = hiciste)
metístet: meter + te — you put yourself, you hid (preterite 2nd sg. metiste + enclitic reflexive te; metístet tras el escaño 'you hid behind the bench'; = te metiste)
vales: valer — you are worth (present 2nd sg.; menos vales 'you are worth less'; = vales)
çercamos: çercar — we surrounded, ringed (preterite 1st pl., the same form as the present; Nós çercamos el escaño 'we ringed the bench'; = cercamos; ç sounded ts)
curiar: curiar — to guard, look after (infinitive, Latin cūrāre; por curiar nuestro señor 'to guard our lord'; = cuidar, closest guardar)
fos: ir + se — he went (preterite 3rd sg. fo, restored by Pidal as f[o], + enclitic -s(e); fos poral león 'he went toward the lion'; = se fue)
esperó: esperar — he/it awaited (preterite 3rd sg.; a mio Çid esperó 'it waited for my Cid'; = esperó)
dexósle: dexar + se + le — it let (itself), let him (preterite 3rd sg. dexó + enclitic reflexive se + le; dexósle prender al cuello 'it let him take it by the neck', of the lion, Pidal 'dejó que él le cogiese por el cuello'; = se le dejó, se dejó)
riébtot: reptar + te — I challenge you (present 1st sg. riebto, with diphthong, spelt riébto, + enclitic te; Riébtot el cuerpo, Pidal literally 'te reto tu persona', a formula of the challenge; = te reto; cf. riebto 'formal challenge', reptado)
traidor: traidor — traitor (masc.; the form traidor beside traydor; = traidor)
éstot: esto + te — this … (to) you (esto 'this', object, + enclitic dative te; Éstot lidiaré 'this I shall fight out with you'; = esto te)
lidiaré: lidiar — I shall fight; of a charge, I shall uphold it by judicial combat (future 1st sg.; esto lidiaré, Éstot lidiaré, Yollo lidiaré, the challenger's formula, Pidal 'sustentar por medio de una lid judicial, una acusación'; = lidiaré, sostendré en lid)
otorgarás: otorgar — you will confess, admit (future 2nd sg.; tú lo otorgarás 'you will confess it', of the beaten man in a judicial combat, Pidal 'tu lo confesarás'; = confesarás)
verdadero: verdadero — truthful, true (adj. masc. sg.; verdadero seré yo 'I shall prove truthful'; = verdadero)
quedó: quedar — it stayed, ended, was left (preterite 3rd sg.; aquí quedó la razón 'here the talk ended'; = quedó)
linpios: linpio — clean, pure, of unstained descent (adj. masc. pl.; de los co[m]des más li[n]pios 'of the purest counts', Pidal 'ilustres, puros, de limpia sangre'; = limpios)
fuessen: seer — they were, would they had been (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; optative with a past sense, non fuessen apareçidos 'would that they had not come about'; = fuesen)
apareçidos: apareçer — come about, carried out (past part. masc. pl., with seer as auxiliary; non fuessen apareçidos 'would they had never been carried out', Pidal 'no se hubiesen efectuado'; = aparecidos, efectuados)
consagrar: consagrar — to become kin by marriage (infinitive; por consagrar con mio Çid 'to become kin to my Cid', Pidal 'emparentar', see conssagrar, v. 1906; = emparentar; not modern consagrar 'consecrate')
repentimos: repentir + se — we repent (present 1st pl. + reflexive nos; no nos repentimos 'we do not repent'; = nos arrepentimos)
bivan: bivir — they live (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; mientra que bivan 'as long as they live'; = vivan)
sospiros: sospiro — sigh (masc. pl.; aver sospiros 'to have sighs, to grieve'; = suspiros)
retraydo: retraer — reproached, cast in one's teeth (past part. masc. sg.; se[e]r les ha retraydo 'it will be reproached to them'; = reprochado; not modern retraer 'withdraw')
ardido: ardido — bold, valiant (adj. masc. sg.; el más ardido 'the boldest'; = ardido, now rare in this sense, closest valiente)
calla: callar — be silent (imperative 2nd sg.; Calla, alevoso 'be silent, treacherous man'; = calla)
alevoso: alevoso — treacherous, faithless; a treacherous man (adj./noun masc. sg., vocative, from aleve 'treachery'; Calla, alevoso 'be silent, treacherous man'; kept apart from traidor 'traitor', both in one line; = alevoso)
saliste: salir — you went out (preterite 2nd sg.; saliste por la puerta 'you went out by the door'; = saliste)
metistet: meter + te — you put yourself, you hid (preterite 2nd sg. metiste + enclitic reflexive te; metistet al corral 'you hid in the yard'; = te metiste)
fústed: ir + te — you went (preterite 2nd sg. fuste, + enclitic te written -d; fústed meter 'you went and put yourself', Pidal 'fuístete a meter'; = te fuiste)
vestist: vestir — you put on, wore (preterite 2nd sg., Pidal's vesti[st]; non vestist el manto 'you did not wear the mantle (again)'; = vestiste)
yollo: yo + te + lo — I … it to you (yot lo, with t and l run together into ll; Yollo lidiaré 'I will fight it against you', Pidal 'yo te lo lidiaré'; = yo te lo)
dirás: dezir — you will say (future 2nd sg., syncopated; por tu boca lo dirás 'you will say it with your own mouth'; = dirás)
mintist: mentir — you lied (preterite 2nd sg., -ist for -iste; mintist de quando dicho has 'you lied in all you have said'; = mentiste)
fincado: fincar — remained, left over (past part. masc. sg., Pidal's finc[ado]; la razón ha fincado 'the talk has ended'; = quedado; not modern hincar 'drive in')
armiño: armiño — ermine (masc. noun, as an adjective of the mantle; manto armiño 'an ermine mantle'; = armiño)
rastrando: rastrar — trailing, dragging along the ground (present part.; un brial rastrando 'a tunic trailing'; = arrastrando; not modern rastrear 'to track')
vermejo: vermejo — red, ruddy (adj. masc. sg.; vermejo viene 'he comes red-faced'; = bermejo)
almorzado: almorzar — having breakfasted (past part. masc. sg.; ca era almorzado 'for he had breakfasted'; = almorzado)
darie: dar — would give (conditional 3rd sg., -ie ending; ¿Quién nos darie nuevas …? 'who would give us renown …?', Pidal '¿quién diría que habíamos de recibir nobleza …?'; ¿Quil darie … a casar? 'who would let him marry …?'; = daría)
ovirna: Ovirna — the river Ubierna, which runs past Vivar (rio d' Ovirna; Pidal: the river takes its name from a place, Ovirna or Ubierna; = Ubierna)
molinos: molino — mill (masc. pl.; los molinos picar 'to dress the mills (millstones)'; = molinos)
picar: picar — to pick, dress (a millstone) (infinitive; los molinos picar 'to dress the millstones', Pidal 'picar sus molinos'; the trade sense is our gloss; = picar)
maquilas: maquila — miller's toll, the grain or flour paid to the miller for the grinding (fem. pl.; prender maquilas 'to collect the tolls', Pidal 'cobrar maquilas'; = maquilas)
suele: soler — is accustomed, is wont (present 3rd sg.; commo lo suele far 'as he is wont to do it'; = suele)
quil: qui + le — who … him (interrogative qui, = quién, + dative le; ¿Quil darie con los de Carrión a casar? 'who would let him marry into the house of Carrión?', a reading; = quién le)
almuerzas: almorzar — you breakfast, eat (present 2nd sg., with diphthong; Antes almuerzas que vayas a oraçión 'you eat before you go to prayer'; = almuerzas)
fártaslos: fartar + los — you glut them, sicken them (present 2nd sg. fartas + enclitic los; a los que das paz, fártaslos aderredor 'those you give the kiss of peace, you sicken them all round', the sense a reading; = los hartas)
âmigo: a + amigo — to a friend (a + amigo run together, Pidal's circumflex; non dizes verdad a amigo ni a señor 'you tell no truth to friend or lord'; = a amigo)
falsso: falsso — false (adj. masc. sg., spelt -ss-; falsso a todos 'false to all'; = falso)
amistad: amistad — friendship (fem. noun; en tu amistad 'in your friendship'; = amistad)
telo: te + lo — you … it (dative te + lo, written apart, between the infinitive and the restored he of a split future; Fazer telo [he] dezir 'I will make you say it', Pidal fazértelo he dezir; = te lo)
calle: callar — let it be silent, cease (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; Calle ya esta razón 'let this talk cease now'; = calle)
reptado: reptar — challenged (past part., after an 'have'; los que an reptado 'those who have challenged'; = retado; cf. riebto)
lidiarán: lidiar — they will fight (future 3rd pl.; = lidiarán)
acaban: acabar — they finish, end (present 3rd pl.; acaban esta razón 'they finish this speech'; = acaban)
ojarra: Ojarra — Ojarra, a knight, envoy of the infante of Navarre (a Basque name, Pidal: otsoarra 'lobuno', 'wolfish'; = Ojarra)
yéñego: Yéñego — Íñigo (personal name; Pidal 'Yéñego, hoy Iñigo'; Yéñego Simen[ones] 'Íñigo Jiménez', envoy of the infante of Aragon; = Íñigo)
simenones: Simenones — Jiménez (patronymic, Pidal's Simen[ones]; Pidal compares an Enneco Semenones, 'o Iñigo Jiménez'; = Jiménez)
infante: infante — infante, prince, king's son (masc. sg.; el infante de Navarra 'the infante of Navarre'; = infante)
rogador: rogador — petitioner, the go-between who asks for the bride on the suitor's behalf (masc. sg., Pidal's [rogador]; Pidal: the envoys are rogadores to whom the brides are granted and given, to hand them over to the new husbands; cf. rogadores, v. 2080; = intercesor)
ifante: ifante — infante, prince (spelt ifante, = infante; el ifante de Aragón 'the infante of Aragon'; = infante)
reinas: reina — queen (fem. pl.; por seer reinas 'to be queens'; = reinas)
bendiçión: bendiçión — blessing (fem. noun; a ondra e a bendiçión 'in honour and with blessing', Pidal 'como mujer legítima', i.e. as lawful wives; = bendición)
callaron: callar — they fell silent (preterite 3rd pl.; = callaron)
ascuchó: ascuchar — he/it listened (preterite 3rd sg.; ascuchó toda la cort 'the whole court listened'; = escuchó)

__broaden__.di: dar — I gave (strong preterite 1st sg.; non gelas di yo 'I did not give them (to them)'; = di) · decir — say (imperative 2nd sg.; Di, Ferrando 'say, Fernando'; = di)
__broaden__.otorga: otorgar — he confirms, bears out; grants, consents (present 3rd sg.; assi lo otorga don Pero 'so Don Pero confirms it', of Fernando's claim; = otorga, confirma) · otorgar — confess, own (imperative 2nd sg.; otorga esta razón 'confess this', Pidal 'confiesa esto'; = confiesa)
__broaden__.o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away') · also o — then, opening a question that follows from what precedes (¿o quien gelas diera …? Pidal '¿quién, pues, …?') · por o — 'wherefore, for which reason' (o = where/which; por o menos vales 'for which you are worth less'; = por donde, por lo cual)
__broaden__.menos: menos — least, less · menos fallar — to find missing, to miss (de los sos menos non fallaron 'of their own men they missed no more than fifteen') · also a menos de — 'without, short of' (a menos de batalla non pueden den quitar 'short of a battle they cannot get clear of it') · menos — in menos vales/valedes 'you are worth less', lost honour (the legal menos valer)
__broaden__.malo: malo — bad; un dinero malo, 'one bad penny' — a debased coin, naming the smallest thing worth mentioning · malo — wicked, base (por malo e por traidor 'as wicked and a traitor'; Calla, … malo e traidor 'hush, wicked traitor'; = malo)
__broaden__.cuerpo: cuerpo — body (= cuerpo; perder el cuerpo 'to lose one's life') · el cuerpo — one's person (Riébtot el cuerpo, Pidal literally 'te reto tu persona', a formula of the challenge; = la persona)
__broaden__.viene: venir — he comes (present 3rd sg.) · venir — it comes (present 3rd sg. with a thing as subject; ¿non te viene en miente lo del león? 'does the affair of the lion not come to your mind?'; = viene)
__broaden__.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar) · tanto quanto 'as long as'; por quanto … ha 'for all that there is' (por quanto en el mundo ha) · also en quanto — 'as far as, insofar as' (En quanto podemos 'as far as we are able'; = en cuanto) · por quanto — 'because, inasmuch as' (por quanto las dexastes 'because you left them'; = por cuanto) · de quanto 'of all that' (de quanto he dicho 'of all I have said'; = de cuanto)
__broaden__.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned') · also fo — went (ir; mañanas fo Minaya 'in the morning Minaya went'); fo de moros 'it came from the Moors' (ser de + noun of origin; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — it was, ser + adjective predicate (Buena fo la de Valençia 'good was the (capture) of Valencia'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — was (the man) of, belonged to (ser de of a vassal; el que de Albar Fáñez fo 'he who was Álvar Fáñez's man'; = fue) · also en estas nuevas fo 'was in on these doings, took part' (ser en 'to be involved in'); fo padre 'was the father' (ser + noun predicate) · fo + infinitive — 'went (and)' (se fo levantar 'he got up', ir + infinitive; = se fue a levantar)
__broaden__.partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part') · also 'to divide, apportion' (partir tod aqueste aver 'to divide all this wealth') · also partir (se) — 'to break up, be dissolved' (of an assembly; split future partir se a la cort 'the court will be dissolved'; = disolverse, partirse) · partir — 'the ending' of a fight (Al partir de la lid 'when the fight is over'; = al terminar; reading from context)
__broaden__.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está) · also non avie recabdo — there was no counting or reckoning (de los colpes de las lanças non avie recabdo 'the lance blows could not be reckoned'; sense uncertain, from the 'account, reckoning' sense; Pidal gives no note here) · also recabdo — answer, reply, heed (el una al otra nol torna recabdo 'neither gives the other heed or answer'; sense taken from context, Pidal gives no note) · recabdo — good sense, prudence (En lo que fabló avie poco recabdo 'there was little sense in what he said'; = recaudo; sense from context, Pidal gives no note)
__broaden__.qual: qual — which (relative/interrogative adjective; de qual part 'from whichever side'; = cual) · qual — 'as' after tal (tal eres qual digo yo 'you are such as I say'; = cual)
__broaden__.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place') · also es a + infinitive 'is to be done, must be done' (impersonal; Ya lo vidieron que es a fer 'they saw that it had to be done'; = hay que hacer) · also es — is, with a predicate noun after a genitive (el uno es [del] infante de Navarra [rogador] 'the one is the infante of Navarre's petitioner'; = es)
__broaden__.ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message') · ca yo non — 'and not I' (Vos las casastes antes, ca yo non 'you married them off before, and I did not'; Pidal 'y no que'; = y yo no)
__broaden__.fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form) · also ir — he should go (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., the preterite stem of seer shared with ir; que f[o]sse con Minaya 'that he should go with Minaya'; = fuese) · also seer — I were (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg.; commo si fosse delant 'as if I were present') · also ir — let him go (off) (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in a scornful wish; F[o]sse a rio d' Ovirna 'let him go off to the river Ubierna', Pidal 'Váyase'; whether a reflexive se is run in is uncertain; = váyase, fuese)
__broaden__.paz: paz — peace (= paz; moros en paz 'Moors at peace', i.e. those who have submitted) · dar paz — to give the kiss of peace (a los que das paz 'those to whom you give the kiss of peace', Pidal 'besas', of the pax Domini at Mass; = dar la paz)
__broaden__.prender: prender — to seize, arrest (infinitive; = prender) · also prender — to take, accept (prender so don 'to take his gift'; = tomar, aceptar) · also prender — to collect, take in (prender maquilas 'to collect the miller's tolls', Pidal 'cobrar maquilas'; = cobrar)
__broaden__.do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde) · also do — wherever, whenever (generalizing, with subjunctive: do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; the exact sense is uncertain) · also dar — I give (present 1st sg.; d'aquí vos do mi graçia 'from here I give you my favor'; = doy) · also do — for don, 'lord' (title before a name; el obispo do Jero[me] 'the bishop don Jerome') · fasta do — until (fasta do despertó mio Çid 'until my Cid awoke', Pidal 'hasta que despertó'; = hasta que)
